visual_brief: Browne Falls（新西兰峡湾国家公园 Doubtful Sound 的 Hall Arm 上方）：从 Browne 湖流出的白色阶梯状瀑布沿雨林覆盖的峡湾陡壁曲折而下直入深色海面，约 836 m；经典视角是 Doubtful Sound 游船上仰望。易混：Deep Cove 的 Helena Falls、Milford Sound 的 Stirling / Bowen Falls。
notes: 无合格可商用照片，建议出图。试过：Flickr API（可商用：browne falls、doubtful sound waterfall/falls/cascade、hall arm、patea，以及 Browne Falls 坐标 -45.398,167.080 周边地理框）、Flickr 全许可检索（Browne Falls 实拍全是 All rights reserved 或 CC BY-ND，不可用）、Openverse、Pixabay、Web 搜索（Pexels/Unsplash 无该瀑布）。地理框内的 CC 照片（cifraser1、a200/a77Wells、Rod Waddington、Mark Gillow 等）逐张查看都不是 Browne Falls（峡湾全景或别处直落瀑布），已删除。现图 Floyd Wilde（CC BY-SA 2.0，wondermondo）原图本身只有 1000×750，无更大版本。理想画面（英文）：Browne Falls above Hall Arm, Doubtful Sound, Fiordland, New Zealand, seen from a cruise boat on the fiord: a long white ribbon of steep tiered cascades zig-zagging down an extremely steep fiord wall covered in dense dark-green native rainforest, from the hanging-valley lip near the top all the way into the dark still water at the bottom; bright soft light with low mist wisps, calm reflective water in the foreground; vertical composition with the whole cascade centred; NOT a single free-falling plunge like Stirling or Bowen Falls (Milford Sound), no boat railings, no people.
pick_reason: Browne Falls 的可商用实拍只有 1000×750 一张（裁后高 750），其余实拍均为保留版权或禁演绎许可，建议出图。
